in_line: If you still feel like a kid inside, somebody who seems grown-up can feel like salvation, and letting them do some of the grown-up jobs for you can actually help for a while. But they can know things you don’t and still be wrong for you to follow too much. The test is whether the relationship makes you more grounded, truthful, and free.
section: Borrow the Adult To Become the Adult

in_line: That’s exactly why I was crying for 14 years. Beginning at the age of 12, when I really started to understand that life is brutal for most people, I became convinced that being happy myself, while others weren’t, was selfish. I had this poster in my room that really resonated with me, by the famous socialist, Eugene V. Debs. I told this to a therapist in college and she actually agreed it was a good reason to be depressed!
